entries.name: Pre-purchase inspection
entries.description: Walk a vehicle you are considering buying. Designed to be completed offline, in someone else's driveway, in about thirty minutes. Generic on purpose and not a substitute for a mechanic's inspection — the thresholds are common guidance, so check anything marginal against the standards where you live.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop

entries.name: Roadworthy quick check
entries.description: A ten-minute walk around before a long drive. Deliberately short: a check nobody completes is worse than a shorter one everybody does.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop

entries.name: Gasoline engine, normal service
entries.description: A starting point for a modern gasoline car or light truck driven mostly on longer trips. Generic and conservative — check every interval against your own owner's manual, which is the only source that knows your engine.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop

entries.name: Gasoline engine, severe service
entries.description: The same vehicle used the way most people actually use one — short trips, cold starts, towing, dust, or heavy idling. Most manufacturers publish a severe schedule and most owners qualify for it without realizing. Generic; check against your owner's manual.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop

entries.name: Generic diesel, severe service
entries.description: A short-interval schedule for a light diesel truck that tows, idles, or runs dusty roads. Intervals are conservative on purpose; check them against your own owner's manual before applying.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop

entries.name: Small engine equipment
entries.description: Generators, mowers, pressure washers and similar four-stroke equipment, scheduled on running hours rather than distance. Intervals follow the pattern common to small air-cooled engines; check the equipment's own manual, which will be shorter than you expect.
entries.author: HomeAutoShop
